title: Past decisions: retros and post-mortems
theme: Решения в прошлом: ретро, постмортем, сожаления
can_do: Сказать, что надо было сделать иначе: We should have tested it on more devices.
Сделать уверенную догадку о прошлом: Someone must have changed the settings.
Описать, что было бы, если бы: If we had started earlier, we would have finished on time.
Выразить сожаление о настоящем и прошлом: I wish we had more time, I wish I hadn't agreed.
Провести короткий разбор ошибки на ретро без поиска виноватых.

points.title: should have and could have
points.explain_ru: should have + третья форма: надо было, но не сделали (критика или сожаление). shouldn't have: не надо было, а сделали. could have + третья форма: была возможность, но она не случилась (We could have finished earlier). Это главный язык ретро и постмортема: что пошло не так и что можно было сделать иначе.

examples.en: We should have tested the update on more devices.
examples.ru: Надо было протестировать обновление на большем числе устройств.

examples.en: You shouldn't have promised the client a date.
examples.ru: Не стоило обещать клиенту дату.

examples.en: We could have finished earlier if the specs had been clear.
examples.ru: Мы могли бы закончить раньше, если бы требования были понятны.

examples.en: You could have told me about the delay!
examples.ru: Мог бы и сказать мне о задержке!

examples.en: I should have asked for help sooner.
examples.ru: Надо было раньше попросить помощи.

ru_trap.wrong: We should test it better last week.
ru_trap.right: We should have tested it better last week.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "надо было протестировать" строится как "надо" + прошлое. В английском should само прошедшим не бывает: о прошлом говорят should have + третья форма.

points.title: must have, can't have, needn't have
points.explain_ru: Догадки о прошлом: must have + третья форма значит "наверняка, точно" (The server must have restarted). can't have или couldn't have: "не может быть, чтобы" (She can't have seen it). Отрицание уверенной догадки строится через can't have, а не mustn't have. needn't have + третья форма: сделали, а оказалось не нужно (We needn't have printed the slides). Сравни: didn't need to print = не печатали, потому что не нужно было.

examples.en: The server must have restarted overnight: the logs are empty.
examples.ru: Сервер, видимо, перезагрузился ночью: логи пустые.

examples.en: She can't have seen the message; she was on a plane.
examples.ru: Не может быть, чтобы она видела сообщение: она была в самолете.

examples.en: We needn't have prepared so many slides: the client only wanted a demo.
examples.ru: Зря мы готовили столько слайдов: клиент хотел только демо.

examples.en: Someone must have changed the settings.
examples.ru: Кто-то наверняка поменял настройки.

examples.en: He couldn't have finished the task already, it's huge.
examples.ru: Не мог он уже закончить задачу, она огромная.

ru_trap.wrong: He mustn't have seen the email.
ru_trap.right: He can't have seen the email.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "он, должно быть, не видел" подталкивает к mustn't. Уверенное "не может быть" о прошлом по-английски can't have или couldn't have.

points.title: Third conditional
points.explain_ru: Третье условное говорит о прошлом, которого не было: if + had + третья форма, потом would have + третья форма. If we had tested it, we would have found the bug (не протестировали и не нашли). Вместо would бывают could have и might have. После if would не ставится.

examples.en: If we had tested it on Android, we would have found the bug.
examples.ru: Если бы мы протестировали на Android, мы бы нашли баг.

examples.en: If the client hadn't changed the scope, we would have finished on time.
examples.ru: Если бы клиент не поменял объем работ, мы бы закончили вовремя.

examples.en: We wouldn't have lost the data if we had made a backup.
examples.ru: Мы бы не потеряли данные, если бы сделали резервную копию.

examples.en: If I had known about the risk, I would have told you.
examples.ru: Если бы я знал о риске, я бы тебе сказал.

examples.en: We might have won the contract if our price had been lower.
examples.ru: Может, мы и выиграли бы контракт, если бы цена была ниже.

ru_trap.wrong: If I would have known, I would have helped.
ru_trap.right: If I had known, I would have helped.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "бы" стоит в обеих частях. В английском would только в части с результатом, а после if нужен had + третья форма.

points.title: wish and if only
points.explain_ru: wish + прошедшее время: хочется, чтобы сейчас было иначе (I wish I had more time = жаль, что времени мало). wish + had + третья форма: сожаление о прошлом (I wish I hadn't agreed = жаль, что согласился). wish + would: хочется, чтобы кто-то другой изменил поведение (I wish the client would answer). If only значит то же, но сильнее.

examples.en: I wish I had more time for side projects.
examples.ru: Жаль, что у меня мало времени на свои проекты.

examples.en: I wish we hadn't promised such a tight deadline.
examples.ru: Жаль, что мы пообещали такой жесткий срок.

examples.en: If only I had saved the file!
examples.ru: Если бы только я сохранил файл!

examples.en: She wishes she spoke German better.
examples.ru: Ей хотелось бы лучше говорить по-немецки.

examples.en: I wish the client would answer my emails.
examples.ru: Хоть бы клиент отвечал на мои письма.

ru_trap.wrong: I wish I have more time.
ru_trap.right: I wish I had more time.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "хотел бы, чтобы было" прошедшее прячет. В английском после wish о настоящем время сдвигается назад: have → had, can → could.

words.example: Everyone makes mistakes; the question is what we learn.
I regret not asking more questions at the start.
In hindsight, we should have hired a tester earlier.
How can we avoid the same problem next time?
A simple check would have prevented the outage.
We overlooked a small detail in the contract.
We underestimated the time the migration would take.
The outcome was better than we expected.
The delay had serious consequences for the client.
The goal of a retro is to learn, not to blame.
The quick fix turned out to be a bad idea.
There were warning signs, but nobody noticed them.
It was the right decision at the time.
What can we improve in the next sprint?
The plan wasn't realistic from the start.
At the retrospective we discussed what went wrong.
The post-mortem showed that the alert had been switched off.
The root cause was a missing test for old devices.
We added the lessons learned to the project wiki.
Speed against quality was a conscious trade-off.
Each action point from the retro has an owner.
The outage lasted three hours.

items.prompt: The release broke the payment page. We ___ it more carefully.
Why didn't you call me yesterday? I ___ (could / help) you.
You should told me about the problem earlier.
answers: You should have told me about the problem earlier.

items.prompt: The office is dark and empty. Everyone ___ home already.
She ___ (can't / read) my email: she was on a plane all day.
He mustn't have seen the message: he was offline all day.
answers: He can't have seen the message: he was offline all day.
He couldn't have seen the message: he was offline all day.
He cannot have seen the message: he was offline all day.
He could not have seen the message: he was offline all day.

items.prompt: If we had started earlier, we ___ on time last month.
If the client ___ (not / change) the requirements, we would have launched in May.
If I would have known, I would have come.
answers: If I had known, I would have come.
If I had known, I'd have come.
If I had known, I would've come.
If I'd known, I would have come.
If I'd known, I'd have come.
If I'd known, I would've come.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ more time to learn Spanish, but I'm working two jobs.
I wish I ___ (not / agree) to such a tight deadline last month.
If only I know the answer right now!
answers: If only I knew the answer right now!
